lines.en: Footsteps light, following you.
Chase the prey, never give up.
Bow at hand, ready to strike.
Peril in the deep forest.
Alert, waiting for the chance.
Silent hunter, in the silence.
I lighten my steps along the footprints.
Sharp eyes, no escape.
Silent steps, hard to find.
Follow the scent, to the end.

lines.zh: 一千格以内，你都在我心里。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, you are on my mind.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印，慢慢来。
lines.en: I follow your footprints, taking my time.
Bow strung, ready at any time.
Wait for the moment, like a statue.
Bow taut, ready to fire.
Hidden in the forest, patient.
Bow hunting, patience is key.
Bow and arrow, waiting to strike.
Deep in the forest, waiting.
Silent bow stance.
Wait for the kill.
Bow in hand, waiting quietly.

lines.zh: 换一张脸，我还是瞄着你。
lines.en: New face or not, I'm still aiming at you.

lines.zh: 你举火把的手，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the hand holding your torch.
Come closer, prey.
Your movements give you away.
I'm going to kill you.
New skin, same hunt.

lines.zh: 我的准星压在你后颈上。
lines.en: My aim rests on the back of your neck.
The string is drawn to my ear — don't move.
You can't escape my arrow.
You're locked in my sights.
A new skin will not hide my intent.
I stand here and let you run first.

lines.zh: 我有一百五十点血，你呢？
lines.en: I have a hundred and fifty. How much do you?
New skin, same wound.
Got hit hard.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，照样追你。
lines.en: I drag one leg and keep chasing you anyway.
Got trapped.
Got stabbed.
Got shot.
Got hit by fall.

lines.zh: 我这具身子换皮，不换痛。
lines.en: This body of mine changes skins, not pain.
Fur hurt.
This wound will not change the ending.

lines.zh: 听到脚步声，箭矢在弦上。
lines.en: Arrows at the ready, hearing footsteps.
Claws gleaming, targeting prey.
Traps waiting, prey nears.
Following scent, relentless pursuit.
Stalking prey, bow taut.
Nightfall, traps set.
Patience, prey ensnared.
Claws tighten, hearing footsteps.
Peering in, bow drawn.
Trap triggers, prey falls.
Colliding with lava, burnt by flames.
Bumping into stone, retreating.
Colliding with player, painful roar.
Bumping trees, leaves flying.
Knocking over chests, pieces scattered.
Bumping traps, mechanisms activate.
Colliding with player, arrows fired.
Bumping into walls, claws break.
Colliding with lava, ashes remain.
Bumping water, splashing.
Calling for mate, response comes.
Chasing mate, following closely.
Meeting mate, gentle embrace.
Successful mating, exhausted rest.

lines.zh: 猎场里没有同类，只有猎物。
lines.en: There's no kin in this hunting ground — only prey.
Attracting mate, making sounds.
Chasing mate, never ceasing.
Mating failed, parting ways.
Mating done, quietly leaving.
Before the story ends, I find a mate.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的背包，不走了。
lines.en: I plant my foot on your pack and stay.
I crouch to study your footprints.
New skin, same scent.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的掉落，记下味道。
lines.en: I pick up your drop and memorize the scent.
I'm eating you.
This pool of blood is what you left behind.

lines.zh: 我拾起你掉的箭，还给你。
lines.en: I pick up the arrow you dropped and give it back.
This is my territory.
This pile on the ground is yours.
I pick up the bow you dropped.

lines.zh: 我这张脸换过一次，还认得路。
lines.en: I changed faces once; I still know the way.

lines.zh: 你的火把往哪走，我就往哪。
lines.en: Wherever your torch goes, I go.

lines.zh: 一千格，够我听见你喘气。
lines.en: A thousand blocks is close enough to hear you breathe.
Prey in the trap.
Prey in sight.
I wait for you to step into that pit.
Target acquired.

lines.zh: 你踏进猎场，就别想出去。
lines.en: Step into my hunting ground and you won't leave.

lines.zh: 脚步声，我听到了，就在那边。
lines.en: Footsteps — I heard them, over there.
Clear target.

lines.zh: 一千格内，你逃不出感知。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, nothing hides.
Your scene has come — you're the prey now.
The story wants me to find you.
In this ending, you are the prey.
The scent matches. It is you.
I can see your torch.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的退路，一段段封。
lines.en: I seal off your escape route stretch by stretch.
New skin, same prey.
The bow is full drawn and even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 你跑得没我快，这是事实。
lines.en: You can't outrun me — that's simply a fact.

lines.zh: 一千格之内，你休想躲开。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, you can't hide.

lines.zh: 下一个路口，我已经在等。
lines.en: At the next crossing, I'm already waiting.

lines.zh: 你数着步子跑，我数着箭。
lines.en: You count your steps; I count my arrows.
This is my target.
Attacking prey.

lines.zh: 下一个路口，我已经在了。
lines.en: I am already at the next crossing.
Do not look back; the bow is drawn.
You cannot outrun me.
At the next corner, I wait.
You are walking into my trap.
A thousand blocks is room enough to play.

lines.zh: 一千格内，你的脚步我全听见。
lines.en: A thousand blocks out, I hear your steps.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路记下来了。
lines.en: I have memorized your way out.
My sights rest on the back of your neck.
Three more steps and it ends.
I have practiced this shot a long time.

lines.zh: 换个面孔，还是同一双手。
lines.en: Another face, the same pair of hands.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道，隔着雾我都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell prey even through the fog.

lines.zh: 骨头的响声，我最爱听了。
lines.en: The sound of bone is my favorite thing.

lines.zh: 一千格之内，你都在我眼里。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, you are in my sight.
My claws know your blood.

lines.zh: 刀从阴影里递出来，很快。
lines.en: The blade comes out of the shadow, fast.

lines.zh: 我隔着一千格就闻到你。
lines.en: I smell you from a thousand blocks.
Taste my fangs!
Prey, prey!
The blade comes out of the shadow.
Hold still. I aim for the heart.
This is the second act. You cannot live.
My knife is light, and fast.
You dodged. Only once.
Blood spatters on the oak.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住第二刀。
lines.en: Your armor will not stop the second cut.
Do not scream; it draws others.
Prey struggling is my favorite sight.

lines.zh: 我这一刀是留给结局的。
lines.en: I saved this cut for the ending.
Fall, and the story gets good.

lines.zh: 我从树后换了张脸出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the tree in a new face.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，我就进林子。
lines.en: One click of the spawn egg and I'm in the woods.
New target!

lines.zh: 我从阴影里换了一张脸。
lines.en: I swapped faces in the shadow.
Hunter in the shadows!
Chasing prey!

lines.zh: 追踪范围很宽，气味更宽。
lines.en: My tracking range is wide. The scent is wider.
I will destroy you!

lines.zh: 这一片阴影里，躲不开了。
lines.en: In this patch of shade, nowhere to hide.
My prey!
The story advances; the hunter enters.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，我就在林子里。
lines.en: The spawn egg clicks, and I am in the woods.
This time I picked a new face.
Phase one begins. Run.
Fire caught my cloak.

lines.zh: 我从崖上滚下，腿骨裂了。
lines.en: I roll off the cliff and crack a leg bone.
Water. My worst ground.

lines.zh: 猎枪还举着，耳朵先聋了。
lines.en: My gun is still up. My ears went first.
I pull your arrow out and will return it.
The spell burns across this new face of mine.
Fainted from hunger.
Change my skin; I still hunt.
Fell into void.
